_note: A small, standalone family: broad early-medieval Slavic (East/West/South variants). Only one clean member (Velesan); Slavic otherwise appears in CROSS-family blends authored with their partner families: Venedan (6+13 Germanic x Slavic), Rovan (8+13 Norse x Slavic, the Rus), Kypchan (13+17 Slavic x Steppe). Those blends should reflex their Slavic component from the theonym_set below. Base provides the concept inventory, morphology template, shared roots, the clanhold title structure, and the Slavic theonym morph-set. Orthography is ASCII (sh/zh/ch/shch for the sibilants; soft signs dropped).

clean: kyivan (Kievan-Rus with a Hellenic overlay, civ)

phonology.palette: Slavic: palatalization (soft/hard consonants); the sibilants sh/zh/ch/shch; consonant clusters; vowels a e i o u y; dithematic glory-names (-slav, -mir, -volod); endings -ov/-ev/-ich, -grad, -a; stress mobile.

sub_palette_notes.slavic: Broad early-medieval Slavic: knyaz/voevoda/boyar register; rod (clan) and druzhina (war-band); -ov/-ich patronymics; grad/gorod towns; the volkhv priesthood and kapishche idol-shrines.

phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC and heavy clusters (str, zdr, sht, vl, mn); palatalized pairs; mobile stress.

lexicon_concepts._note: Same concept inventory as the other family bases; realized in the culture kit.

shared_roots._note: Common Slavic roots (common words and titles, allowed; theophoric built only on the morphed canon-forms below, never real Slavic gods).

theonym_set._note: Slavic morphs of the Agrippan canon: phoneme-morphs through Slavic phonology (v>b/v; -us>-u/-on; sibilant shifts). These are NOT real Slavic gods (no Perun, Veles, Svarog, Dazhbog, Mokosh, Stribog, Lada, Morana). The culture-name Velesan/Velesia is a traditional proper name only. Velesan realizes these directly; cross-family Slavic blends (Venedan/Rovan/Kypchan) reflex their Slavic component from here.

morphology_template.patronymic_form: patronymic -ov/-ev/-ich (son of); rod (clan) name + -ichi; the Dedy (ancestral spirits) honored.
morphology_template.compounding_rule: dithematic glory-names (-slav glory, -mir peace/world, -volod rule): Velislav, Borimir; toponyms quality + feature: Chorn-boloto (black-swamp).

title_ladder_structure._note: ACKS 7 tiers, clanhold. Built on knyaz (prince): knyaz at principality, velik knyaz (grand prince) at kingdom, kagan (over-king of many princes) at empire. The veche (folk-assembly) checks the knyaz; the volkhv (priest) stands outside the ladder. Tier->ruler-level mapping pending the ACKS lookup.

conventions.people_name_default: dithematic glory-name (-slav/-mir) + patronymic -ov/-ich or rod; deed/nature byname for the renowned; order given-first.
conventions.transparent_vs_opaque: moderate-high; many names are transparent compounds.
